CVE-2026-132858.title: A flaw was found in gdm. The CreateRemoteDisplay D-Bus method fai ...
CVE-2026-132858.description: A flaw was found in gdm. The CreateRemoteDisplay D-Bus method fails to perform proper authorization checks when initiating a remote display session. A local attacker with access to the login screen environment can invoke this method with an arbitrary username to bypass standard automatic login verification checks. This vulnerability allows the attacker to achieve privilege escalation and start an unauthorized session as any user on the system, including root.
